title: Unit Event — Chase My Ideal Idol! — Episode6 To the Stage!

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! receives an offer to appear at Idol Lovers Festival, the big break for many young idol groups. During rehearsals, Airi is shocked by the performance of another group...

rows.Line: The day of Idol Lovers
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Oh no...!
Look at how big that crowd is out there...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Tickets did sell out again this year.
Even the extra seats they set up at the edges are all filled.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I always get pretty anxious, but this is Idol Lovers...! I don't think nervous begins to describe how I feel right now...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Normally, I'd tell her to calm down, but I'm in the same boat as her this time around.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Only young idol groups are allowed to perform here. Their hunger, drive and ability to shine is what makes this event.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (The ones who perform here have honed their singing and dancing skills to a fine point...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I've always dreamed of becoming an idol who can dazzle others like them.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (And now, I get to go on that stage.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Everyone's focus will probably be on ReLight for this event. So, even if I do give it absolutely everything I have, I won't come close to them or the ideal idol I've envisioned.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But I've done everything I can leading up to this. All I have to focus on now is one thing.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Spreading hope to as many people as we can through our performance!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Um, Airi...?
Are you by chance feeling nervous right now?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I do like your serious expressions, Airi, but I was hoping to see you smile the way you usually do...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess I am getting a little too worked up. My brow's probably all furrowed...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I can't go out there like this, can I?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But I feel more relaxed now.
Thanks, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We get to take the stage at Idol Lovers, so let's go out there and have as much fun as we can...!
Idol Lovers Stage

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Th-This is it...!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Next on stage is MMJ, right?!

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: But are you really sure about us watching them from here? What if one of the attendees recognizes us?

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Don't worry! Only people involved with the event are allowed around here, and the equipment should keep the crowd from seeing us!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
But most of all!
We get to see MMJ perform as members of the audience♪

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: That doesn't mean we shouldn't be worried...

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: Yeah, but I kinda get how she feels.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
In any case!
We should forget about being seen and turn our attention to the stage!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: This is their first event since that legendary solo show, so they're for sure gonna blow us all away!

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Yeah, true...

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line:
MMJ really is something else.
They just keep getting more and more popular with each TV appearance. It's like they're able to do everything that we can't...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Oh, it's starting!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hello, Idol Lovers!
Are you all having fun?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope the other idols haven't filled you up with too much energy already.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Even so! You guys are ready for some more, right?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We're MORE MORE JUMP!
And we're gonna send you guys flying sky-high!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sing along, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
Whoa...
They seamlessly transitioned between introducing themselves and singing...

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line:
Which means they're in perfect sync.
It's always so hard to get that just right...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
Their performance is so good.
I really love the way Momoi dances.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
I mean, she's just so cute!
Plus, whenever we make eye contact, she makes it feel like she's looking at just me. Like we've known each other forever...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: Did Momoi always dance like that...?

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
This is so different...
It's like she isn't just Momoi the really cute idol I've become used to seeing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys!
We're still just getting started here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Let's have some fun together!
Raise your arms way up in the air for me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And try to keep up!

rows.Speaker: Audience Member A
rows.Line:
Wait, isn't that Momoi?
A.k.a. Happy Everyday...?

rows.Speaker: Audience Member B
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
I've never thought of her as a great stage performer until now since she was such a big variety show star.

rows.Speaker: Audience Member B
rows.Line: I didn't know she could make these kinds of expressions.

rows.Speaker: Audience Member A
rows.Line: She's really stealing the show...

rows.Speaker: Record Company Employee
rows.Line:
MORE MORE JUMP, huh...
I'd heard that they're good, but not this good.

rows.Speaker: Show Producer
rows.Line:
I'm just as surprised.
I guess this is what makes Idol Lovers such a great event.

rows.Speaker: Show Producer
rows.Line: I didn't think another group could go toe-to-toe with ReLight.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: They really are putting on an amazing performance.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I wasn't expecting this at all.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: And we still have to do that joint performance. We need to stay focused...

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
Or else...
They're going to swallow us whole.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: MMJ really is amazing.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: They're always showing us different sides of who they are and keep bringing new surprises to the table. Just watching them makes me smile...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: That's why they're my heroes.
